exact_two_cycle_resource_theorem.closed_resource_scope: Same preparation reference reused; two phaseful readout references, one initially empty battery, a position-controlled gap schedule and one finite clock packet are supplied. No reference or battery erasure is performed.
exact_two_cycle_resource_theorem.ideal_reset_scope: Full exchange transfers the active source state and its correlations into the battery. It does not erase information. The static controller separately retains imperfect reset and reflected-clock outcomes.
